title: Auditing Before Automation: Shortcut-Aware CXR Triage — reproducible notebook and results
description: Complete, reproducible computational workflow and results supporting the article 'Auditing Before Automation: Shortcut-Aware Hierarchical Selective Triage of Pneumonia and Tuberculosis on Chest Radiographs': image-identity auditing, candidate near-duplicate grouping and chaining diagnostics, group-aware partitioning, frozen-encoder direct and hierarchical classification, calibration, conformal prediction, calibration-locked selective referral, metadata negative controls with an exploratory evidence-gate rule, robustness analyses, and a single-source second-dataset check.
